lead: A `secret` cannot be measured from source, so a width invariant is asserted through the members bounded by it.
body: `Core\Bytes::length($key)` on a `secret bytes` is `E0401`, because `rule:security/secret-qualifier` does not widen downwards. Assert every draw is accepted by the members that refuse every other width, and name the width over plain `bytes`, as `crypto-names-the-key-length-bound-on-both-sides.nvst` does.
